acceptanceCriteria: Changing a protocol-owned work-item-outcome fact changes CLI capability output, MCP schema/validation, and generated reference facts together without hand-editing multiple facts.
CLI parsing and MCP validation continue to accept the same supported values and reject unknown values.
Generated English, Simplified Chinese, and Japanese interface regions remain deterministic and preserve manual explanatory text.
Description-only discovery performs no repository observation, verification, or child validation process.
The tri-language Work Item projection and reference-parity rows are present before terminal archive and preserve the same contract/evidence identity.
The protocol re-export surface exposes the same interface facts used by both adapters and generated references.
goal: The work-item-outcome interface description, CLI parser, MCP schema/validator, and generated reference regions share one maintained fact source with deterministic parity tests.
intent: Remove duplicated work-item-outcome interface facts by deriving CLI and MCP discovery from one protocol-owned definition while preserving current parsing, validation, and transport behavior.
